name: Ocean City & Assateague
summary: Maryland's honky-tonk beach boardwalk, then the wild barrier island where feral horses roam the dunes.

foodMustTry.name: Boardwalk Thrasher's fries & Fisher's popcorn
foodMustTry.blurb: Vinegar fries and caramel corn — the OC boardwalk classics.

days.label: Day 131 — The Boardwalk
days.summary: Three miles of classic beach boardwalk.

item.title: Ocean City Boardwalk
item.blurb: Rides at Trimper's and the pier, arcades, saltwater taffy, and a wide Atlantic beach.

days.label: Day 132 — Assateague's wild horses
days.summary: A barrier island left to the sea and the horses.

item.title: Assateague Island National Seashore
item.blurb: A wild, undeveloped barrier island where feral horses wander the dunes and beach — kayak the bay or just watch them.

rest.label: The beach, and nothing else
rest.note: A barrier island, an ocean, wild horses wandering through the dunes, and no schedule. This is the last unhurried beach before the trip turns inland for the Blue Ridge.

days.label: Day 133 — Northwest to Frederick
days.summary: A long haul across the state to Civil War country.

commute.scenicNote: West across the Bay and up to the Piedmont near Antietam.
